source_location.excerpt: This report provides a detailed overview of all incidents and problems encountered, managed, and resolved by Primevolta Hardware Solutions for FinSecure Services during November 2025. The objective of this report is to track incident trends, analyze recurring problems, document resolutions, and provide recommendations to prevent recurrence, thereby maintaining high availability and operational efficiency across BFSI hardware systems.

During this reporting period, 145 incidents were logged, including 12 critical incidents affecting core servers and network infrastructure. The report also includes problem management summaries, root cause analyses, corrective actions, and SLA performance metrics.
Monitored incident response and resolution times.
Majority of incidents were hardware-related (60%), followed by network issues (25%), and end-user devices (15%).

Recurring Problems: Server disk failures and network latency accounted for 40% of repeated incidents.
Time to Resolve: Average resolution time was 1.8 hours, meeting SLA targets.
First-Time Resolution Rate: 88%, with remaining 12% requiring escalations or hardware replacement.
